exposure: Obstetric coverage models (hospitalists, faculty generalists, private practice generalists)
cohort: Singleton, term (>=39 weeks), vertex patients undergoing induction of labor at NYU Langone Hospital-Long Island between January 1, 2022, and September 30, 2022.
finding: Induction-to-vaginal delivery times and overall complication rates were similar across different obstetric coverage models, but variations were observed in NICU admissions and cesarean delivery times.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed in induction-to-vaginal-delivery time across groups, but private generalists had the shortest induction-to-cesarean time.
